answer: A newcomer earns standing only by completing a voyage through three independent guilds, each assigning a different checkable job and stamping one terrace checkpoint on a public ledger. Standing rises one terrace at a time and reaches its zenith only after all three guilds confirm distinct, non-reused work. Reusing any output, or letting one guild vouch twice, burns every earlier checkpoint and forfeits a posted bond. A Sybil farmer therefore pays full labour, fees and bond per fake identity, with no bulk discount and no shortcut past the sequence.
